East Alabama Medical Center

429 Beds
Acute Care Hospitals
OPELIKA, AL
Part of East Alabama Health
Current ERP: Infor
Version: S3
Multiple sources confirm that East Alabama Medical Center utilizes Infor solutions for various operational functions, including an announcement from Velocity Technology indicating their use of Infor/Lawson products. Multiple sources indicate that East Alabama Medical Center is using Infor/Lawson's suite of products for financials, procurement, and HR, with evidence including references to the "INFOR Paycheck Viewer" and mentions of their status as an Infor customer.

Yes, there is evidence suggesting that East Alabama Medical Center (EAMC), part of East Alabama Health, uses Infor solutions.

Here’s what I found:

  • Velocity Technology announcement: Velocity Technology added East Alabama Medical Center (EAMC) to its growing community of Infor/Lawson system customers. EAMC uses Infor/Lawson’s full suite of products, including Financials, Procurement, and Global Human Resources.
  • Infor Paycheck Viewer: According to the East Alabama Health website, current employees can access their W-2 statements online through the “INFOR Paycheck Viewer.”
  • Technographics: East Alabama Medical Center’s technographics mention Infor being live.
  • I also found a reference to “Lawson Connect” on Wellstar’s website, a hospital in Georgia.

Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding East Alabama Medical Center (EAMC) and Infor:

  • Infor Paycheck Viewer: A 2024 document on the East Alabama Health website refers to the “INFOR Paycheck Viewer” for employees to access their W-2 statements. It seems employees can access it through the EAMC network.
  • Velocity Technology: One search result mentions “East Alabama Medical Center (EAMC) to its growing community of Infor / Lawson system customers.” It also mentions that EAMC is a user of Infor / Lawson’s full suite of products including Financials, Procurement, and Global Human Resources and uses the Infor/Lawson system to conduct its business.
  • Technographics: One source indicates that East Alabama Medical Center has “Infor” listed in their technographics.
  • 2019 User Group Meeting: A search result mentions an “Infor Georgia/Alabama User Group Fall Meeting”

While there’s no definitive press release or case study stating EAMC’s current ERP system, the evidence suggests that East Alabama Medical Center (part of East Alabama Health) utilizes Infor, specifically Infor Lawson, for some of its business processes, including financials, procurement, and HR. The reference to “INFOR Paycheck Viewer” indicates continued use of Infor systems as of early 2024 for payroll purposes.

Thomas Hospital

162 Beds
Acute Care Hospitals
FAIRHOPE, AL
Independent
Current ERP: Infor
Version: Unknown
There is no definitive evidence confirming that Thomas Hospital in Fairhope, AL, has adopted Infor, but indirect indications include a time and attendance system linked to Infirmary Health, its parent organization, which may utilize Infor/Lawson.

Based on my search, here’s what I found regarding Thomas Hospital in Fairhope, AL, and their potential use of Infor or Lawson systems:

Evidence Suggesting Infor/Lawson (or related) Use:

  • Time and Attendance System: A search for “Thomas Hospital Fairhope AL” and “Lawson login” found a time and attendance login page for Infirmary Health (Thomas Hospital’s parent organization) that redirects to an identity provider [22]. This login page mentions UKG (Ultimate Kronos Group) and prompts users to call 435-PAYS or email payroll@infirmaryhealth.org for questions. While it doesn’t directly confirm Infor, many organizations use ERP systems like Infor/Lawson for time and attendance functions.
  • Job Postings: While not direct evidence, some job postings for Thomas Hospital are found on ZipRecruiter [24], but these do not mention any specific ERP system.
  • Infirmary Health IT Structure: It’s important to consider that Thomas Hospital is part of Infirmary Health [2, 5, 13]. A system used at the Infirmary Health level would likely be used at Thomas Hospital.

Why it’s Difficult to Confirm Definitively:

  • Public Information Limitations: Hospitals often don’t publicize the specific ERP systems they use for security reasons.
  • Varied Terminology: Even if Thomas Hospital uses Infor Cloudsuite, they might refer to it internally by a different name or module name.
  • Acquisition History: The acquisition of Lawson by Infor means that some systems might be referred to as “Lawson” even if they are now part of the Infor suite.

Recommendations

  • Contact Thomas Hospital Directly: The most reliable way to confirm would be to contact their IT department or a relevant administrator.

MOBILE, AL

Springhill Medical Center in Mobile, Alabama, implemented Lawson Software (now Infor) in 2006 to create a unified business system, confirming their use of Infor solutions.

Yes, Springhill Medical Center in Mobile, Alabama, used Lawson Software (now Infor) to create a unified business system.

Here’s what the search results indicate:

  • Lawson Implementation (2006): Springhill Medical Center signed a contract with Lawson Software in November 2006 for Lawson Human Capital Management, Enterprise Financial Management, and Business Intelligence suites. This was to create a unified business system to reduce operational costs and enhance workflow capabilities.
  • Altera Digital Health (formerly Allscripts) EHR: Springhill Medical Center implemented the fully integrated Sunrise EHR platform almost two decades ago, in 2004. They also implemented Sunrise Financial Manager, with Allscripts developers working onsite with Managed Services and Springhill to develop features and functionality.
